xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4258: Planning effort: all five levels for pan plan, PlanDialog defaults to high, and fix the 'LOW effort planning' prompt bug

plan.title: Planning effort: all five levels for pan plan, PlanDialog defaults to high, and fix the 'LOW effort planning' prompt bug
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: Planning effort is a three-level copy of the effort enum. pan start --effort xhigh|max renders 'LOW effort planning' because buildPlanningPrompt treats every non-high, non-medium value as low. claude-code planning never receives an effort (getAgentRuntimeBaseCommand is called without one), other harnesses get the raw unclamped value, and roles.plan.effort is never read. The start-planning API does not validate effort, PlanDialog defaults to medium against the effort-high-default rule, and pan strike --dry-run prints medium while help says high.
narratives.Proposal: Route planning and strike effort through resolveEffort (role plan / role strike) and the contracts enum: pan plan accepts five levels, the start-planning API returns 400 for an unknown level before any mutation, spawnPlanningSession resolves once and passes the clamped level to every harness and to the prompt, the prompt bands by rank (low/medium/high-and-above) so xhigh and max get the deep-analysis section and probe pass, PlanDialog renders EFFORT_LEVELS with DEFAULT_EFFORT via an extracted PlanEffortPicker, strike resolves once for both dry-run and launch, the four lint:effort baseline rows are deleted, and effort.mdx, MODEL-CONTEXT-AUDIT.md and the pan-plan skill describe the new behavior.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Editing src/cli/commands/start.ts (its unplanned-path forwarding of --effort to planning stays; PRD D2)
- Resolving the PlanDialog default from GET /api/effort/default
- src/cli/commands/lane.ts --effort help and other surfaces owned by #4256, #4257, #4259, #4260
- Persisting or displaying planning effort on AgentState, agent rows or cost data (#4259)
- Changing roles/plan.md or roles/strike.md frontmatter
- Changing how pan strike resolves its model
- Defaulting anything to xhigh or max
- Raising any file-size allowlist row

autoDecisions.summary: Planning prompt effort section and probe pass key off the resolved effort level by rank (low / medium / high-and-above), so default planning runs (resolved high) now carry the deep-analysis section and probe pass.
autoDecisions.rationale: The prompt then describes the effort the harness actually runs at; high is the declared default by rule, and PlanDialog defaulting to high already implies the probe for dashboard plans. Keying off the request source would make the CLI and dashboard disagree.

autoDecisions.summary: pan start keeps forwarding its --effort to the planning session on the unplanned path; start.ts is not edited.
autoDecisions.rationale: Documented behavior (pan-start SKILL.md, PAN-3022 D4); the bug is in prompt banding, and start.ts sits at its PAN-4249 line ceiling.

autoDecisions.summary: pan plan does no client-side effort validation; the start-planning API 400 is the single gate.
autoDecisions.rationale: One validation point; plan.ts already surfaces the API error text and exits 1.

autoDecisions.summary: PlanDialog's effort picker moves into a new PlanEffortPicker.tsx.
autoDecisions.rationale: PlanDialog.tsx is over the 1000-line ceiling and may not grow; five levels plus hints would grow it inline.

autoDecisions.summary: pan strike clamps effort against the explicit --model only and passes effort plus effortSource to spawnAgent.
autoDecisions.rationale: Makes the dry-run print exactly what launches without re-implementing spawnAgent's model resolution in the CLI.

autoDecisions.summary: The strike.ts lint:effort baseline row (labelled PAN-4259) is deleted by this issue.
autoDecisions.rationale: Its only match is the dry-run ?? 'medium' fallback that this issue removes.

autoDecisions.summary: All lint:effort baseline edits land in one final item blocked by the four source items.
autoDecisions.rationale: scripts/lint-effort.sh is a shared file; a single item avoids serializing the source items on it, and a dropped count only prints a note so intermediate states pass.

metadata.sizeJustification: The plan touches 15 files. The 7-subsystem count comes from the first-two-segment bucketing treating each single top-level file (configuration/effort.mdx, docs/MODEL-CONTEXT-AUDIT.md, scripts/lint-effort.sh) as its own subsystem; those are the docs and ratchet edits this slice is required to ship with the code, so splitting them into sibling issues would ship behavior without its docs.
